section.title: Spécifications fonctionnelles
section.description: Features, user stories, business rules, edge cases
completion_hints: Business rules are explicit, no implicit assumptions

context_items.content: Les utilisateurs peuvent se connecter avec leur email et mot de passe.
Un tableau de bord affiche les commandes en cours de l'utilisateur.

expected_gaps.description: No acceptance criteria defined for the login or dashboard features
No handling specified for failed login attempts or an empty dashboard state

section.title: Spécifications techniques
section.description: Architecture, stack, integrations, data model, NFRs (perf, security, scale)

context_items.content: Le système doit être rapide et sécurisé.
Les commandes des clients sont stockées dans une base de données.

expected_gaps.description: Performance and security requirements are vague adjectives (rapide, sécurisé), not measurable numbers
No schema or fields defined for the 'commande' entity stored in the database

section.title: Problématique et contexte
section.description: Business problem, current situation, stakeholders, why this project exists
completion_hints: Problem is stated in measurable terms

context_items.content: Le projet vise à améliorer la gestion des commandes pour Danone.

expected_gaps.description: Target users/stakeholders (which teams, roles) are not identified
No measurable success criteria for what 'améliorer la gestion' means
